definitions.explanation: The central or innermost part of something.
The string in a candle that burns.
The graphite stick inside a mechanical pencil.

notes:
{芯|しん} refers to the core or center of things, both literally and figuratively.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {芯|しん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the core, thoroughly)
- {芯|しん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (having inner strength)
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{芯|しん} (the core of one's body)
- ⟦{替|か}え→替える：13399_kaeru⟧{芯|しん} (replacement lead for mechanical pencil)
- {芯|しん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧ (the lead breaks)

COMPOUNDS:
- {芯|しん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (all the way through)
- {芯|しん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (having substance, backbone)
